name: Markov
long_description:
Markov builds expert computer-use datasets for frontier AI labs. Our datasets include screen recordings + mouse/keyboard actions of professionals using CAD, design and enterprise software.

We work with the top AI labs and we’ve gotten more than 350k downloads on HuggingFace. Our long-term goal is to be the full stack platform for computer-use AI, starting with data and then the infrastructure to train and deploy computer-use models.

Dev and Harish are technical co-founders. Dev studied aerospace engineering at IIT Madras and was the youngest team member at Sarvam - India’s top AI lab. Harish is an Emergent Ventures grantee and his prior robotics work was featured in top national publications.

launches.title: Markov - Data for computer-use AI
launches.body:
# \*\*\*\*

**TLDR;**

* **Markov builds the data infrastructure for computer-use AI**, collecting synchronized screen recordings, mouse/keyboard actions, and annotations from real workflows.
* **We specialize in hard-to-source expert data** **across CAD, architecture, engineering**, and other professional applications.
* **We’ve already sold 15,000+ hours of data to frontier AI labs** and open-sourced leading computer-use datasets with **150k+ downloads on HuggingFace**.

<https://youtu.be/WervE6pZ9TM>

**The Problem:**.

While frontier models have gotten much better at reasoning, they still struggle to reliably complete long, multi-step workflows across real desktop software. **The biggest bottleneck is the lack of high-quality training data.**

Training these models requires **synchronized screen recordings, mouse and keyboard actions, and high-quality annotations from people doing real work**. This is especially scarce for expert workflows in domains like CAD, architecture, engineering, finance, and other professional software.

**That’s where we come in:**

We work with a vetted network of expert contributors to collect high-quality computer-use data across:

* Consumer applications
* Productivity software
* Accounting and finance
* CAD, architecture, engineering, and other expert workflows

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109874&key=user_uploads/1783684/ba673ff4-e489-4753-b11b-4797762834fb)

**So far we've:**

* Sold more than 15,000 hours of data to frontier AI labs
* Open-sourced the [**largest dataset of computer-use screen recordings**](https://x.com/DevvMandal/status/2032104265121140924?s=20)(**150k+ downloads on HuggingFace**)
* Released the [**largest open gaming computer-use dataset**](https://x.com/DevvMandal/status/2072357115847671990?s=20)

**Our Ask:**

If you're building computer-use agents and need high-quality training data - or have interesting workflows you'd like collected - we'd love to chat **:)**

Book a meeting with us at <https://cal.com/dev-markov/30min> Or shoot us an email at [founders@markovstudios.com](mailto:founders@markovstudios.com)
